name: com.mobilevalidate/mcp
title: MobileValidate
description: Check phone numbers (WhatsApp, Telegram, carrier, spam reputation) and e-mail addresses.

environmentVariables.name: MOBILEVALIDATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: MobileValidate agent key (mv_agent_…, scoped and spend-capped) or test key (mv_test_…). Live keys are rejected.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CONFIRM_ABOVE_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spend above this amount (USD) needs the user's explicit confirmation.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: a MobileValidate agent key (mv_agent_…) or test key (mv_test_…).

api_key.description: MobileValidate agent key (mv_agent_…) or test key (mv_test_…).
